lines.zh: 我感受到了你的灵魂……它将属于我！
lines.en: I feel your soul... it belongs to me!
Death is your destination!

lines.zh: 不要反抗，你将加入我的行列！
lines.en: Do not resist, you will join my ranks!

lines.zh: 我的骑士之魂指引我来到这里！
lines.en: My knight’s soul led me here!
Your fear will serve me!

lines.zh: 追随我，成为不朽的一部分！
lines.en: Follow me, become part of the unending!

lines.zh: 你的武器已经失去了力量！
lines.en: Your weapons are already powerless!

lines.zh: 死亡之风将带走你的生命！
lines.en: The wind of death will take your life!
I am the vengeance spirit of the End!

lines.zh: 你的灵魂将会成为我的战利品！
lines.en: Your soul will be my trophy!

lines.zh: 这条末地小径，我走了太久。
lines.en: I have walked this End path far too long.
My mount neighs; I go on with sword drawn.
Soul Cohesion
Blade Glints
Knight in Shadows
Forward in Darkness
Spear of Yamato
Flame of the Dead
Power Awakens
Death's Breath
Dragon's Fury
Dark Guardian

lines.zh: 我感到你的气息，凡人。你逃不过我的审判。
lines.en: I feel your presence, mortal. You cannot escape my judgment.

lines.zh: 我的利剑渴望你的鲜血，为我战斗吧。
lines.en: My sword thirsts for your blood. Fight for me.

lines.zh: 你们都一样，终究是逃不过灭亡的命运。
lines.en: You are all the same. You will all eventually face annihilation.

lines.zh: 我的坐骑，准备好了吗？让我们去收割灵魂。
lines.en: My steed, are you ready? Let's go and harvest souls.

lines.zh: 你的眼中闪烁着恐惧，但我不会怜悯你。
lines.en: Fear flickers in your eyes, but I shall not show mercy.

lines.zh: 我是末地的裁决者，我的命令无人能违。
lines.en: I am the judge of the End. My commands are law.

lines.zh: 我的每一次挥砍都将你推向深渊，凡人。
lines.en: Each of my swings pushes you further into the abyss, mortal.

lines.zh: 你认为你能战胜我？你太天真了。
lines.en: Do you think you can defeat me? You are too naive.

lines.zh: 你的同伴们很快就会加入你。
lines.en: Your companions will soon join you.

lines.zh: 我的宝弓等待着我的命令，它将引导我们走向胜利。
lines.en: My hunting bow awaits my command. It will guide us to victory.
Soul burns.
Wind of death.
Honorable fall.
Infinite night.
Sworn to decay.
Call of the end.
End of the knight.
Pride of fall.
Knight of darkness.
Soul's lament.

lines.zh: 这匹坐骑强大而忠诚。骑上它，与我并肩作战！
lines.en: This steed is powerful and loyal. Mount it and fight by my side!

lines.zh: 它的皮甲闪耀着邪恶的光辉。用它来加强你的防御吧！
lines.en: Its armor glows with evil light. Use it to enhance your defense!

lines.zh: 弓箭的力量在我手中凝聚。它将成为你终结敌人的利器！
lines.en: The power of the bow gathers in my hands. It will be your锐器 to end enemies!

lines.zh: 你的力量不足以驾驭我。投降吧，成为我的手下！
lines.en: Your strength is not enough to command me. Surrender and become my servant!

lines.zh: 你的眼中闪烁着求生的欲望。我可以救你，成为我的同伴！
lines.en: Your eyes shine with the desire to survive. I can save you, become my companion!

lines.zh: 恐惧你的命运吧，凡人！我的利剑将引导你走向灭亡！
lines.en: Fear your destiny, mortal! My sword shall lead you to destruction!

lines.zh: 你的勇敢让我感兴趣。让我来训练你，成为我的得力助手！
lines.en: Your bravery interests me. Let me train you to become a formidable aide!

lines.zh: 与我同行，你将获得永生！成为不死的一员，永不消逝！
lines.en: Travel with me, and you shall gain immortality! Become one of the undead, never to fade away!

lines.zh: 你的灵魂如此纯净，但不适合这个末地。让我来引导你吧！
lines.en: Your soul is so pure, but not suited for the Nether. Let me guide you!

lines.zh: 你似乎对我有着兴趣。来，让我展示我的力量给你看！
lines.en: You seem interested in me. Come, let me show you my power!

lines.zh: 我感到一股邪恶的力量在召唤我，这是我的使命。
lines.en: I feel a dark force calling me, this is my duty.

lines.zh: 这具躯壳曾是高贵的战士，如今只为死亡而战斗。
lines.en: This body was once a noble warrior, now it fights only for death.

lines.zh: 堕落不是终点，只是另一种形式的存在。
lines.en: Falling is not the end, just another form of existence.

lines.zh: 我曾是光明的守卫者，现在我是黑夜的使者。
lines.en: I was once a guardian of light, now I'm a messenger of darkness.

lines.zh: 骑上我的坐骑，感受末地的冰寒。
lines.en: Ride my mount, feel the chill of the End.

lines.zh: 敌人近了，死亡的寒风吹拂。
lines.en: The enemy is near, the wind of death blows.

lines.zh: 每一次挥剑都是对生命的剥夺。
lines.en: Every swing of my sword is a剥夺 of life.

lines.zh: 灵魂之火在我心中燃烧，永不停息。
lines.en: The flame of the soul burns within me, never ceasing.

lines.zh: 你将为我的亡灵之舞献上最终的祭品。
lines.en: You will be the final sacrifice for my dance of the undead.

lines.zh: 狩猎之弓，赋予我更致命的力量。
lines.en: Hunter's bow,赋予 me more lethal power.

lines.zh: 死亡伴侣，共同在暗夜中翱翔。
lines.en: Death's companion, fly together in the dark night.

lines.zh: 末影的拥抱，让我们的灵魂相连。
lines.en: The embrace of the Ender, let our souls be united.

lines.zh: 堕落不是终点，而是永恒的开始。
lines.en: Falling is not the end, but the beginning of eternity.

lines.zh: 在末日的光辉中，寻找永恒的伴侣。
lines.en: In the light of the End, find an eternal partner.

lines.zh: 堕落骑士的誓言，永生与你同行。
lines.en: The Fallen Knight's vow, eternal with you.

lines.zh: 在死亡的舞蹈中，找到我们的归宿。
lines.en: In the dance of death, find our home.

lines.zh: 灵魂的绑定，让我们的力量更强。
lines.en: The binding of souls, let our strength grow.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的一束光，指引我们永恒的路。
lines.en: A ray of light in the darkness, guiding our eternal path.

lines.zh: 死亡之吻，让我们的灵魂融合。
lines.en: A kiss of death, let our souls merge.

lines.zh: 在末日的钟声中，我们的生命永续。
lines.en: In the bell of the End, our lives continue.

lines.zh: 我是亡灵骑士，被黑暗灵魂所驱使。
lines.en: I am a Fallen Knight, driven by dark souls.

lines.zh: 我的弓箭上附有诅咒，击中你将永坠黑暗。
lines.en: My bow is cursed, striking you will plunge you into darkness forever.

lines.zh: 我的盔甲曾属于勇士，现在却用来打击敌人。
lines.en: My armor once belonged to a warrior, now it strikes enemies.

lines.zh: 这具盔甲曾是敌人的荣耀，现在却是我的武器。
lines.en: This armor was once an enemy’s honor, now it’s my weapon.

lines.zh: 邪恶坐骑是我的同伴，共同战斗。
lines.en: My evil steed is a companion, fighting together.

lines.zh: 在雪林中，我是最后一个守卫。
lines.en: In the snow forest, I am the last guardian.

lines.zh: 我的每一次攻击都是为了终结你的生命。
lines.en: Every attack is for the end of your life.

lines.zh: 我的弓箭射程极远，一箭毙敌。
lines.en: My bow has a long range, a single arrow can kill.

lines.zh: 邪恶坐骑可以带我冲锋。
lines.en: My evil steed can charge.

lines.zh: 击杀我时，有几率掉落狩猎之弓。
lines.en: When I am defeated, there is a chance to drop a hunting bow.

lines.zh: 感受我的剑锋吧，末地的来犯者！
lines.en: Feel the edge of my sword, invader of the End!

lines.zh: 凋灵女巫，来和我一起终结吧！
lines.en: Withering Witch, come and end with me!

lines.zh: 坠落的骑士，我的宿命敌！
lines.en: Fallen Knight, my destined foe!
Evil mount, charge!

lines.zh: 诅咒药水，强化我的攻击！
lines.en: Cursed potion, enhance my attack!
Fallen Knight, my destined foe!
Seek your demise in despair!
Death's kiss, falls upon you!
Swing my sword to end you!
Shadow of fear, draws near!
I hear the prey breathing.
The fallen knight's lance is raised.
This body belongs to my bow now.
Do not run; no soul escapes me.
The curse potion boils in my blood.
Sword drawn, frost crackles
Phantom knight, in the night
Flames of souls ignite
Curse your soul
Steal your courage
Sword pierces through
Wrath of undead
Dark knight descends
My bowstring is already drawn tight.
Evil steed roars

lines.zh: 我骑着的坐骑，蹄子没有声音。
lines.en: My mount's hooves make no sound.
Bow drawn full; hold still.
My mount circles to your flank.
Your shield is trembling.
My blade pins your retreat.
The snowwood wind covers me.

lines.zh: 我的坐骑在阴影里等你。
lines.en: My mount waits in the shadow.
One strike will be enough.
Fueled by rage
Swing sword
Dark shadows attack
Soul bound
Strength fades
Death approaches
Curses fall
Evil steed
Battle in the End
Echoes of sorrow
My blade splits your armor.
This blow carries a curse.
My mount bowls you over.
The string sings; the arrow lands.
My lance punches through the shield.
Fall, mortal.

lines.zh: 我来自深渊，黑暗是我的盔甲。
lines.en: I come from the depths, darkness my armor.

lines.zh: 寒冷的风在我盔甲间呼啸。
lines.en: The cold wind whistles between my armor.
No sympathy in this End.

lines.zh: 我挥舞着长剑，每一击都致命。
lines.en: I swing my sword, every strike致命.

lines.zh: 我的坐骑，是恐惧的化身。
lines.en: My steed, a化身of fear.

lines.zh: 远处的警报，预示着战斗的到来。
lines.en: The distant alarm signals impending battle.

lines.zh: 猎人们，准备好迎接死亡吧。
lines.en: 猎人们, get ready for death.
This bow will witness my victory.

lines.zh: 我将在这片土地上，永世长存。
lines.en: I will endure in this land.

lines.zh: 每一次呼吸都充满战斗的气息。
lines.en: Every breath is filled with the scent of battle.

lines.zh: 我从末地的裂缝里爬出。
lines.en: I crawl out of an End rift.
Old arrows still stick in my armor.
This body wakes once more.

lines.zh: 狩猎之弓随我一同降临。
lines.en: The hunting bow arrives with me.
Burning agony
Fall into a ravine
Drowning suffocation
Explosion blast
Arrow pierces my armor
Curse magic corrodes me
Starvation weakens my strength
Lightning strikes me
Void tears my soul
